sources.title: GitHub - henrytanner52/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
sources.snippet: The project aims to train sentence embedding models on very large sentence level datasets using a self-supervised contrastive learning objective. We used the pretrained nreimers/MiniLM-L6-H384-uncased model and fine-tuned in on a 1B sentence pairs dataset.

sources.title: all-MiniLM-L6-v2: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a sentence transformer model maintained by Xenova that encodes sentences and paragraphs into 384-dimensional dense vectors for semantic search, clustering, and similarity tasks.
